name: launchkit
description: Gives freelancers and agencies a client-ready website demo to pitch with, before any real design work starts. Next.js 15, Auth.js, Prisma, swappable content provider.

paragraphs: Generate a client-ready website demo in minutes: something concrete to put in front of a prospect before any real design or development work begins.
📄 Read the case study: architecture decisions, real bugs hit, and how each was diagnosed and fixed.
Note on the live demo: this project isn't currently deployed. It runs locally in about a minute with zero setup. See Getting Started below.
features: 3-step project wizard: business info → template → review & generate

7 industry templates: Real Estate, Gym/Fitness, Dental Clinic, Restaurant, Law Firm, Consultant, Local Business, each with a genuinely different hero layout, section order, and visual theme, decoupled from industry so…
Live visual editor: edit headlines, descriptions, services, FAQs, and CTA text with the preview updating on every keystroke; regenerate at any time while keeping the chosen template
Responsive preview: desktop/tablet/mobile toggle before you ever share the link
Shareable public link: every project gets an unauthenticated /demo/[slug] page, clearly labeled as an AI-generated demo concept, ready to send to a client

whatItDoes.text: Generate a client-ready website demo in minutes: something concrete to put in front of a prospect before any real design or development work begins.

requirements.text: It works entirely out of the box: a built-in content engine writes real, varied copy per industry with no API key required, and a real LLM (OpenAI or Anthropic) can be swapped in later behind an environment variable with no code changes: useful, but never a requirement to use the product.
Authentication: email/password signup, plus a one-click demo account so anyone can try it without registering
A demo tool that requires an API key before a prospect (or a recruiter) can try it creates unnecessary friction.

9 end-to-end tests across 3 files (Playwright) cover demo login, signup, route protection, sign-out, full project creation → generation, live editing with persistence, and the public shareable demo link.
